title: Dungeon decor and hazards: banners, statues, shelves of books (Water Bolt), spikes that hurt, per-object loot
player_outcome: Dungeon walls carry Terraria's banners (Marching Bones Banner, Necromantic Sign, Rusted Company Standard, Ragged Brotherhood Sigil, Molten Legion Flag, Diabolic Sigil). Statues stand in alcoves and shelves hold books, one of which may be the Water Bolt. Spike strips bite if you walk into them.
design: New TileObjectDef field Hazard { Damage, Knockback } (src/Strata.Core/Content/Defs/TileObjectDef.cs).

New partial src/Strata.Core/Session/GameWorld.Hazards.cs: TouchHazards(p), called from TickPlayer next to StepOnPlates. It scans the cells overlapping the player's box grown by 0.05 m (about 16 lookups) and, for objects with Hazard, rolls DamageModel against the player's defense, applies Vitals.Hurt with the normal immunity, and reports through Npcs.ReportPlayerDamage with knockback away from the spike.
WorldEditor.BreakObject: non-container objects with a per-instance PendingLoot roll it instead of Def.Loot (books; later special pots).
6 banners (Terraria ids above): size [2,4,1], anchor Wall, natural false, tags [world, banner].
statues skeleton_statue, armor_statue, angel_statue: size [2,4,2], tags [world].
spike: size [1,1,1], anchor Any, natural false, hazard {damage 40, knockback 6}, hitPoints 1, covers terraria:spike.

Blender: new tools/blender/bgen/dungeon_decor.py. banner: a cloth panel with a sagging hem, rod and painted emblem (params: colours, emblem shape). statue: a grey-stone figure from primitives and detail.organic on a pedestal (poses: skeleton, armor, angel). book: a small tome with 4 colour variants. spike: 5 iron cones on a plate.
assets.json entries; build_all.py --only for the new ids; reference rows.
